Aisha: Who's watching the Final Four tonight? Thinking of a last-minute fantasy roster swap lol :eyes: Also — watch party at the office? :popcorn:
Tom: I'm in. Bringing wings. Prediction: UConn by 6. @Aisha you owe me a jersey if Villanova pulls it off :stuck_out_tongue:
Priya: Count me in for wings but not the jersey bet. I'll take Villanova +8 🤞
Ben: Fantasy dilemma — bench Edwards for Jalen? Anyone on the fantasy channel around to trade quick?
Aisha: Quick poll — react with 🏀 for UConn or 🐺 for Villanova. I'll tally when I get to my desk.
Priya: 🐺 (voted)
Tom: 🏀 (voted) :muscle:
Ben: Also FYI my lineup diff if anyone cares:
```
- SG: Edwards -> OUT
+ SG: J. Sarr -> IN
```
Ben: Thoughts? Edwards has a risky matchup tonight.
Priya: I'd bench Edwards. J. Sarr's usage looks up in the last 3 games.
Aisha: Good call. I'll drop Edwards and pick up Sarr if waiver clears.
DevBot: Reminder: office kitchen reservation system open until 5pm — cancel if you change plans.
Aisha: Cool — I'm reserving Conf Delta for a 7pm watch. Wings, snacks welcome. Anyone bringing sides?
Tom: I'll bring hot sauce + napkins.
Ben: I'll grab some beers (non-alcoholic options too).
Priya: I'll bring a salad. Also, quick heads-up — folks in the fantasy league: trade window closes at midnight.
Aisha: Perfect. See y'all at 7. May the best bracket live to regret itself tomorrow :sweat_smile:
Tom: :thumbsup:
Ben: GLHF everyone!
